stijl: Editorial interior photograph as shot by a professional interior photographer in a real, lived-in Dutch home. Natural window daylight, soft shadows, matte materials, believable furnishing, calm and slightly lived-in styling. Visible wood grain, fabric texture and wallpaper texture. Shot on a full-frame camera, 35mm lens, f/5.6, eye level, true-to-life colours. Avoid: HDR look, plastic gloss, exaggerated background blur, perfectly symmetrical showroom render, CGI look, text, logos, watermarks, people.

beelden.prompt: Living room in a Dutch 1930s terraced house. One full wall behind a low, light-grey linen sofa is covered with vertical oak acoustic slat panels mounted on black acoustic felt. Daylight enters from a tall window on the left through an off-white linen sheer curtain. Oak floorboards in straight planks, a woven wool rug, a small walnut side table with a ceramic lamp and a stack of books, a throw on the sofa.
beelden.techniek: The slats are perfectly straight and vertical, all the same width (about 27 mm) with an even dark felt gap (about 10 mm) between them; the panel field starts and ends cleanly at the ceiling and just above the skirting board, with a neat end at the wall corner. The floor planks run in one direction, continue logically under the sofa and rug and end against a straight white skirting board. Perspective lines are straight, no warped or bending slats.

beelden.prompt: Close-up detail of natural grasscloth wallpaper on a wall in a Dutch home, warm sand colour. Soft raking daylight from a window on the side reveals the horizontal woven grass fibres, the fine cotton warp threads and the natural colour variation between strips. On the right, the edge of an off-white linen curtain falls in soft, natural folds. The lower part of the image shows a sliver of a painted wooden window sill.
beelden.techniek: Two wallpaper strips meet at one straight, vertical, butt-joined seam; the fibres run horizontally and stay continuous across each strip; slight tonal difference between the two strips is natural for grasscloth. The curtain folds hang vertically from above the frame with believable fabric weight. Sharp focus on the wallpaper texture, gentle falloff, no heavy bokeh.

beelden.prompt: Bedroom in a Dutch home with a calm, small-scale botanical-print non-woven wallpaper in muted sage and off-white on the wall behind a linen-upholstered headboard. A simple oak bedside table with a ceramic lamp and a book. Soft morning daylight from the side.
beelden.techniek: Wallpaper pattern repeats consistently and lines up across vertical strip seams; seams are straight and nearly invisible; the pattern stays undistorted on the flat wall and ends neatly at the ceiling and skirting.
